items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output 7.1 kW replacement)
items.rationale: Surge damage covered under 2.3.3; unit 9 m from hob so 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Per 7.1.9/7.1.10 the upgraded unit is not new equipment but is indemnified only up to an equivalent 3.5 kW like-for-like unit (reference case 38: ~1352-1445).

Labour of removing the old unit and installing and commissioning the replacement is covered under 7.1.9(c), as an ancillary charge following a covered principal item; priced at the reference case 38 level, possibly limited to an equivalent unit.
Under 7.1.10 (last paragraph), a console chosen for appearance and not required for the unit is not a replacement cost at all; it falls under 3.5(d)/7.1.8(a), so t = 0.
Ordinary carriage of a covered replacement is covered under 7.1.9(e)/7.1.12; priced at the reference case 38 level of about 40-43.
Under 7.1.12, surcharges for expedited or timed delivery are not indemnified unless the insurer agreed in advance, which did not happen here.
Administrative and handling charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b); this line type was never indemnified in earlier cases.
